title: /compact on qwen says 'Nothing to compact yet … (~14.9k tokens)' while the footer shows 68% of the window
observed: kiln behaviour (UX). Right after a qwen turn, footer 'ctx ━━━━━━──── 68%' of 49.2k (~33k incl. system prompt and tools). '/compact' replied 'Nothing to compact yet: the conversation (~14.9k tokens) is all recent turns, which are kept as they are.' An explicit /compact does nothing, and the two figures disagree with no explanation of what the other ~18k is.
expected: An explicit /compact compacts (Claude Code's /compact always summarises), or the message explains that the footer counts the system prompt and tools, which compaction cannot shrink.
